site.title: {project} - Ũgayanĩri wa Faele Ũtarĩ na Kĩguũrĩ
site.description: {project] nĩ software ya peer-to-peer ya ũgayanĩri wa faele ĩthondeketwo igũrũ rĩa technologia cia kĩũmbe iria itarĩ na kĩguũrĩ.
site.ogTitle: {project} - Software ya Ũgayanĩri wa Faele Ũtarĩ na Kĩguũrĩ
site.ogDescription: Ũgayanĩri wa faele wa peer-to-peer ũtarĩ na kĩguũrĩ ũigĩte igũrũ rĩa technologia cia kĩũmbe. Hatirĩ servers cia kĩguũrĩ. Hatirĩ kĩndũ kĩa ũmwe kĩa gũthũkia.

hero.subtitle: Ũgayanĩri wa peer-to-peer wa rũciaro rwa rũgendi
hero.description: Ũigĩte igũrũ rĩa technologia cia kĩũmbe itarĩ na kĩguũrĩ. Hatirĩ servers cia kĩguũrĩ. Hatirĩ kĩndũ kĩa ũmwe kĩa gũthũkia.

about.title: Ũhoro
about.intro: {project} nĩ platform ya rũciaro rwa rũgendi ya ũgayanĩri wa faele ya peer-to-peer ĩakĩtwo igũrũ rĩa technologia cia kĩũmbe itarĩ na kĩguũrĩ. Ĩgwatanĩtie interface njega ya mũhũthĩri na ũthondeki ũtarĩ na kĩguũrĩ kabisa, ĩkĩheana ũgayanĩri wa data wa ũgitĩri na wa kwĩhokeka hatarĩ na kwĩhoka harĩ wathani o wothe wa kĩguũrĩ. Project ĩno nĩ open source, ĩgayanĩtio harĩ {license}.

decentralized.title: Mũtaratara ũtarĩ na kĩguũrĩ kabisa
decentralized.description: Hatirĩ servers cia kĩguũrĩ, hatirĩ kĩndũ kĩa ũmwe kĩa gũthũkia. Ahũthĩri macaragia na kũhatũria mathĩna mwena na mwena, hatarĩ na kwĩhoka harĩ indexer, tracker kana database o yothe ya kĩguũrĩ.

accessControl.title: Wathani wa kũhuthĩra wa ũũgĩ
accessControl.description: Mũndũ o wothe nĩagwĩra kwambĩrĩria mũtaratara wake we mwene tũtarĩ na ũtuumi na watho wake mwene. Thĩinĩ wa o mũtaratara, taũra mawĩra ma ahũthĩri: mwene, admin, mũmũrĩkithia, moderator na mũhatũri. Tongoria na ũũgĩ nĩ ũũ ũrĩkũrĩa kũmũrĩkithia, moderate na kũhatũria mathĩna.

ui.title: Interface ya mũhũthĩri ya gĩthemba kĩega
ui.description: Interface ya media center ĩtheru na ya ũrata ĩthondeketwo nĩ ũndũ wa desktop, TV na platforms cia simu. Mucemanio mũhũthũ na keyboard, mouse, gamepad kana remote. Ahũthĩri ari na ũmenyo nĩmoĩa kũrũtithia software ĩno ta server ya faele ĩtarĩ na kĩonekano harĩ command-line interface.

dataFormat.title: Mũtĩrĩro wa data ũmenyekaga nĩ andũ
dataFormat.description: Mũtĩrĩro wa data wa LISH ũigĩte igũrũ rĩa JSON, ũkahũthahũtha kũũmba, gũthoma na kũmenya. Gayania mathĩna maku na metadata ya wega na ya gũtuĩka, mũndũ o wothe ahote kũrora ũhũthũ.

security.title: Ũtoria na ũgitĩri
security.description: Mathugumano mothe ma peer-to-peer mahuthĩte na encryption, gũtigĩrĩra atĩ data yaku ĩtũũraga thiritũ rĩrĩa ĩthamĩtio. Ahũthĩri nĩmehithaga thuutha wa VPN nĩ ũndũ wa kongerera ũtukio. {project} ĩtĩaga ũtoria waku rĩu ĩthondekagwo.

crossPlatform.title: Cross-platform
crossPlatform.description: Software ĩrĩ kuo Windows, Linux na macOS. Ĩhũthĩra harĩ kĩndũ kĩothe ũkwendete.

download.title: Hatũria
download.description: Onia {project} ya platform yaku. Mahatũrio mothe nĩ ma tũtarĩ na ũtuumi na open source.
